summary: Retested Field Engineer (FE) feature end-to-end. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_field_engineer.py — 15/15 passed (FE CRUD via /api/users/field-engineers with RBAC admin-only create/patch, operator read 200, guest 403, FE role 403; inactive FE login blocked; WO list scoping for FE; 403 on other FE's WO for GET/field-data/activity; field-data whitelist rejecting 'pelanggan'; activity clock start/hold/resume/stop with state-machine 400s, hold reason required, invalid fase 422, date sync + persistence). Frontend (Playwright, admin+operator): Test1 /users shows fe-section with fe.budi and creating fe.test works (badge Aktif); Test2 toggle Nonaktif/Aktif works and window.prompt reset password shows toast 'Password fe.test direset'; Test3 new WO (PSB → SURVEY) shows 'Field Engineer (PIC)' dropdown with fe.budi & fe.test, selected fe.budi and saved successfully (WO appears in list); Test4 after FE clock start/hold('TEST HOLD')/resume/stop via API, admin WO form Timeline & SLA shows fe-activity-log with 4 rows MULAI/HOLD/LANJUT/SELESAI + reason, and activity_survey_start/end + stop_survey_start/end auto-filled with today's date; Test5 regression — main users table shows only admin/operator/guest (no fe.*), dashboard + WO list normal, operator can see/assign FE dropdown and has no Users nav link. Cleanup done: test WOs and fe.test deleted, fe.budi kept.

design_issues.screen: WO form → Timeline & SLA (activity_*/stop_* date fields)
issues: Uses native <input type="date"> (browser default picker) instead of the shadcn calendar component used elsewhere in the design system — inconsistent look; also Data Lapangan values are editable inputs, so an admin can silently overwrite FE-synced dates (spec says field data should be read-only in web)
React warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — hydration warning triggered on the WO form page (option children markup); dev-only noise but should be cleaned
GET /api/auth/me fires twice and returns 401 before login (harmless but duplicated call / console error noise)

action_items: OPTIONAL: make FE-synced Timeline & SLA activity/stop-clock date fields read-only in the web form (currently editable by admin/operator), or document that web override is intended.
OPTIONAL: replace native date inputs with the shadcn calendar for consistency.
OPTIONAL: fix React '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' warning on WorkOrderFormPage.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is ~4895 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; split into routers (auth/users, workorders, fe, reports, exports) for maintainability.

GET /users/field-engineers is registered after other /users routes but no /users/{id} GET exists, so no path-shadowing bug — keep this ordering in mind if a /users/{user_id} GET is added later (it would swallow 'field-engineers').
_fe_activity_summary only records the first 'start' and the last 'stop'; re-start after stop is blocked (status 'done'), so a phase cannot be reopened — confirm this is the intended business rule.
FE_EDITABLE_FIELDS whitelist works correctly and rejects protected fields (verified 'pelanggan' rejected and unchanged in DB).
seed_data_creation: Temporary: FE account fe.test / fe.testXXXX and WOs TEST_FE_UI_CUST / TEST_FE_CUST / TEST_FE_OTHER — all deleted at end via /app/backend/tests/fe_cleanup.py. fe.budi preserved.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FE feature fully verified (backend + web UI). Reusable suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_field_engineer.py (self-cleaning). Playwright notes: WO creation requires two pickers first — jenis-pick-PSB then fase-pick-SURVEY (UPPERCASE testids); form section tabs stay disabled until pelanggan + si_id/sa_id are filled; status badges render uppercase via CSS so compare case-insensitively; window.prompt needs an async dialog handler (asyncio.ensure_future(d.accept(...))) otherwise the click hangs. Writing files into /app/backend/tests triggers a uvicorn reload.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defects found. Two earlier test failures were script issues, both fixed in-scope: (1) badge text asserted as 'Aktif' while CSS uppercases it to 'AKTIF'; (2) sync dialog handler never awaited dialog.accept() in the async Playwright API, blocking the page.
